quote: The model is asked to predict the answers and the list of conditions if there is any. An answer to the question has three different types: (1) 'yes' or 'no' for questions such as 'Can I get this benefit?'; (2) an extracted text span for questions asking 'how', 'when', 'what', etc.; (3) 'not answerable' if an answer does not exist in the document.
We present the ConditionalQA dataset, which contains questions with conditional answers.
tasks: Other:Reading Comprehension with Conditional Answer Generation
outputs: answers (yes/no, extractive text spans, or not answerable) and associated conditions (HTML elements)

quote: We evaluate performance of models on the ConditionalQA dataset as a reading comprehension (RC) task. Answers are measured with exact match (EM) and F1. ... F1(•, •) measures the accuracy of the set of predicted conditions at HTML element level.
Answers are measured with exact match (EM) and F1.
We manually check 200 examples in the prediction of the best performed model FiD and label the type of errors made.
